filled.later_source_search_note: never machine-filled; complete machine searches are in _draft.proposals.later_source_search_machine

legend.flags ofr_codification_1989_editorial: a later event or whole-order end read from the OFR 1989 Codification's disposition table (status as of 1989-01-20, OCR cell); whole_end_from_1989_disposition_table marks unqualified revocations offered as whole-order ends under later-events' rule. That table and the later-events OFR catalog notes are the same OFR data, so their agreement is not counted as corroboration by two jobs
legend.gate.errors_if_proposals_accepted: feasibility test only: the suggested candidates and placeholder text were put in a COPY of the claim; whatever still fails there has no machine evidence yet (compact form: clause_*_state x12 means twelve clauses)
legend.gate.errors_now: claim_gate.validate_claim errors of the claim exactly as drafted: the agent's to-do list
legend.gate.only_judgment_left: true when that copy passes the gate: every remaining gap is a judgment the agent makes from evidence already in the draft
legend.gate.placeholder_clause: true when no clause inventory exists: the claim then holds one placeholder clause (DRAFT-PLACEHOLDER-no-clause-inventory) so the gate checks every part (an empty list makes the gate stop early, and the readiness tracker would count the unchecked steps); replace it with the real clauses
legend.later_source_search_partial: machine searches that did not cover the whole corpus (sample runs); their full wording is in SUMMARY.json machine_searches
legend.proposals: candidates already in the claim's field shapes ('proposal'), with 'meta' explaining where each came from; dates are the acting instrument's signing or printed date, never a verified effective date (later-event proposals therefore say date_candidate; rename it to effective_date only after confirming)
legend.proposals.current_predicate[] basis_code: the OFR 1989 Codification prints the order as in force on 1989-01-20 (as amended, editorial text): a lead only; its checked_through is 1989-01-20, so it never satisfies the gate and never counts as a current-law lead
legend.proposals.later_source_search_machine: complete machine searches, never put into the claim: copy the 'entry' of the same search_id from SUMMARY.json machine_searches into claim.later_source_search only after judging it adequate for the order and resolving every CONFLICT line
legend.proposals.original_representation[].acce: false for a compiled transcription (grade compiled_transcription_lead, Richardson): a lead to the official original, never the original by itself; the feasibility test never uses it. official_compilation_* grades are GPO/OFR printings graded like fr-originals (needs_page_check or a medium/low location is never strong)
legend.readiness.by_step: confirm = machine evidence is in the draft or proposals and an agent must check and accept it; agent_judgment = needs reading and a decision; resolve_conflicts = conflicts listed; research = no machine evidence yet; done_now / done_now_by_custody = the tracker already counts it; n/a = not applicable
